sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:53

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:53:1
items.html:
The truth is that the body of man was formed from Yetzira, and this is what “and He formed,” etc., says. And after Beria descended and clothed in Yetzira, it is found that it is as if he was created from Beria. For just as ZA is the discernment of the Yetzira of Atzilut, so Adam HaRishon is the discernment of the lower Yetzira of BYA, that is, from the discernment of a light of offspring. And from this discernment he has no part at all in Bina, which is Beria, and he is not fit for the discernment of Neshama and Mochin. But by the power of the ascent of the bottom Hey to Nikvey Einayim, Bina herself expanded to the discernment of ZON, which are called Yetzira and Assiya, or the ZAT of Bina, in the discernment of VAK [six ends] without a Rosh [head]. And by the power of this, ZON became rooted in Bina. Therefore, although ZA, by the principal part of his emanation, is VAK without a Rosh, even so, when he rises as MAN [Mayin Nukvin] to Bina and returns AVI face to face, through which YESHSUT attain their GAR [first three], ZA too attains, through them, the discernment of Rosh; for this is the rule: whatever the lower one causes in the upper one, that same measure returns to the lower one as well. And in this way the lower man, too, can receive the discernment of Rosh from ZON, for after ZON rise to AVI they become like them. Therefore, although from the beginning of his formation man is not fit for the discernment of Rosh, since he has no part at all in Beria, as above, nevertheless, by his rising as MAN to ZON, he causes them the discernment of GAR also in their part from the Chazeh [chest] downward. And since, without the ascent of man as MAN, ZON had the discernment of GAR only from the Chazeh upward, therefore the measure that man caused to be drawn into the part from the Chazeh downward of ZON he attains in himself as well, and he too attains the discernment of GAR like them. And by this it is regarded that man, who is Yetzira, rose to Beria, for he received GAR from the discernment of Beria and became equal to her. And remember that BYA, and Bina and ZON, and the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of Adam HaRishon are one matter, both in Atzilut and in the lower BYA.
And at the time of the birth of Adam HaRishon the worlds were already in the secret of Beria, as the ARI writes, for the Yetzira and Assiya of Atzilut were already in the place of the Beria of Atzilut, that is, ZON of Atzilut had already risen to AVI of Atzilut. Consequently, the lower BYA and the NRN of Adam HaRishon too, which are their offspring, were born for this reason in the discernment of Beria, for the Guf [body] of Adam HaRishon, which is Yetzira, came out in the place of the six upper ones of Beria. Through this they had a Rosh in Atzilut, in the place of ZON: the Rosh itself, called Bina or Beria, was in the place of ZA of Atzilut, and the throat, which is the GAR of VAK, or the GAR of Yetzira, was in the place of the Nukva of Atzilut.
And this is the secret of the verse, “And HaVaYaH Elokim formed the man,” etc., for it was a whole Yetzira, with a complete Rosh from Atzilut, for HaVaYaH Elokim indicates wholeness. And this is because Yetzira acquired the actual merit of Beria, as above. However, after the sin, when Beria descended again to be Yetzira — which means that the Mochin of GAR that ZA had caused to YESHSUT departed, and YESHSUT descended to VAK without a Rosh, which is Yetzira; and likewise the Mochin departed from ZA, and he returned to the discernment of Yetzira, VAK without a Rosh, which is regarded as his having descended to the place of his part from the Chazeh downward; and likewise man, who had already been in the discernment of Beria, returned to the discernment of VAK without a Rosh — therefore all this is regarded as Beria having descended to be Yetzira. And this is the secret of “And Elokim created the man,” etc., for Elokim indicates the Mochin of Katnut [smallness/infancy], since it is the discernment of Beria that became VAK without a Rosh.
And with this a strong difficulty is settled: for Beria is more important than Yetzira; if so, why is the full name, HaVaYaH Elokim, written in “and He formed,” while in “and He created” only the name Elokim is written? But according to the words of the ARI it is well understood, for “and He formed” refers to the whole Yetzira, that is, after it had become the actual discernment of Beria and had attained a Rosh from Atzilut; therefore a full name is said there. But “and He created” refers to his discernment after the sin, to the discernment of VAK without a Rosh, that is, to Beria that fell to be like Yetzira; therefore only the name Elokim is written, which indicates Katnut. And one should not ask: if so, why is “and He created” written? It should have said “and He formed.” The matter is that he did not return to the actual discernment of Yetzira, for then he would never again have been fit for GAR, as above. Rather, he returned to the discernment of VAK of Beria, through which he is still fit to improve his deeds, so as to raise MAN anew to ZON and to draw Mochin of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] in the same measure that he causes in the upper ones, as above. And this is the precision of “and He created”: to indicate that he still holds on to Beria, but in the Katnut of Beria.
